2608.30922.title: CARVE: Verified Expansion for Variable-Length Generation in Diffusion Language Models
2608.30922.paper_summary: Masked diffusion language models predict tokens from a partially observed response canvas, enabling bidirectional conditioning and parallel token refinement. Yet standard masked-diffusion decoders use a rigid inference interface: the number of masked positions allocated to the answer is fixed before generation begins. Choosing this length is difficult. A short canvas can truncate reasoning or code, while a long canvas wastes computation and can perturb denoising. We introduce CARVE (Counterfactual-Aware Reveal with Verified Expansion), a training-free variable-length algorithm for masked diffusion LMs. Starting from a shorter canvas, CARVE can grow the response during decoding by inserting additional [MASK] positions. Rather than keeping every insertion, CARVE tests a candidate expanded canvas and asks a counterfactual question: would the model make similar predictions for the unresolved positions in the original canvas if the extra masked space were present? The inserted masks are kept only when they induce low Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence on aligned unresolved positions. This makes length growth a verified stability decision rather than a pure confidence heuristic. CARVE applies without retraining to both full-canvas and blockwise diffusion decoders. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CARVE consistently improves average performance over fixed-length baselines across all evaluated model families. Crucially, CARVE achieves these accuracy gains while reducing inference cost, reaching half the FLOPs of fixed-length decoding in some settings.
2608.30922.paper_summary_zh: 被遮罩的擴散語言模型從部分觀察的回應畫布中預測標記，實現雙向條件和並行標記精煉。<lb/>然而，標準的遮罩擴散解碼器使用一個僵化的推理介面：分配給答案的遮罩位置數量在生成開始之前是固定的。<lb/>選擇這個長度是困難的。<lb/>短畫布可能會截斷推理或代碼，而長畫布則浪費計算並可能擾動去噪。<lb/>我們引入了 CARVE（反事實感知揭示與驗證擴展），這是一種無需訓練的變長算法，用於遮罩擴散語言模型。<lb/>從較短的畫布開始，CARVE 可以在解碼過程中通過插入額外的 [MASK] 位置來增長回應。<lb/>CARVE 並不是保留每一個插入，而是測試一個候選擴展畫布並提出一個反事實問題：如果存在額外的遮罩空間，模型是否會對原始畫布中未解決的位置做出類似的預測？<lb/>只有當插入的遮罩在對齊的未解決位置上引起低的詹森-香農（JS）散度時，才會保留這些插入的遮罩。<lb/>這使得長度增長成為一個經過驗證的穩定性決策，而不是純粹的信心啟發式。<lb/>CARVE 可以在不重新訓練的情況下應用於全畫布和區塊擴散解碼器。<lb/>在代碼生成和數學推理基準測試中，CARVE 一直在所有評估的模型系列中提升平均性能，超越固定長度的基準。<lb/>關鍵是，CARVE 在降低推理成本的同時實現了這些準確性增益，在某些設置中達到了固定長度解碼的一半 FLOPs。
